content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hi,

I have reviewed the agreement and would like to suggest a few adjustments before signing:

- Clause 12.2 currently allows the client to terminate the agreement at any time without notice and without further payment. This could leave work unpaid. I propose that either party may terminate for material breach upon fifteen (15) days’ written notice, and that upon termination the client shall pay for all services performed and expenses incurred up to the termination date.
- Clause 6.1 states that all intellectual property rights in each deliverable transfer to the client upon delivery. This would transfer ownership before payment is received. I suggest that the rights transfer to the client only upon full payment for that deliverable.
- Clause 4.2 sets invoice terms at Net 90, which may delay cash flow. I recommend changing the payment terms to Net 30.

Thank you for considering these changes. I look forward to moving ahead.

Best regards
